english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for pretending, including acting falsely, make-believe, and feigning a state.

exampleSentences.english: They always pretend they know everything.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢成日扮到自己乜都識咁。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 baan6 dou3 zi6 gei2 mat1 dou1 sik1 gam2

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for pretending to have a condition or showing a false appearance, such as 扮病.

exampleSentences.english: They feign illness so they do not have to go to work.
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 baan6 beng6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1

english.note: Use this when the dissembling involves pretending to be different or pretending not to feel or think something.

exampleSentences.english: They dissemble by pretending to be completely unfazed even though they are clearly nervous.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢明明好緊張，仲要扮到若無其事。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 ming4 ming4 hou2 gan2 zoeng1 zung6 jiu3 baan6 dou3 joek6 mou4 kei4 si6

english.note: Use 扮 when someone deliberately puts on an appearance or feigns a feeling, rather than genuinely seeming that way.

exampleSentences.english: Don't act pitiful; I know you're fine.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你唔使扮可憐，我知你冇事。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 baan6 ho2 lin4 ngo5 zi1 nei5 mou5 si6

english.note: Use this for adopting a feigned manner or quality, such as acting indifferent.

exampleSentences.english: You don't need to assume an indifferent attitude.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 baan6 m4 zoi6 fu1
